title: The Danger Triangle of Your Face

sections.name: The Danger Triangle of Your Face
lines: There's a triangle on your face that doctors call the danger triangle.
It runs from the bridge of your nose, down to the corners of your mouth.
And it's the worst place to pop a pimple.
The veins here connect to a space right behind your eyes, next to your brain, called the cavernous sinus.
Squeeze a pimple, and you can push bacteria deeper, into those veins.
Very rarely, an infection can travel all the way back, and cause a dangerous clot beside your brain.
It's rare, and antibiotics stop most infections early. But a red, hot, swollen spot here needs a doctor.
So next time, maybe just leave that one alone.
